title: Paints n' Pixels
description: A mod that adds around 70+ New and Unique Paintings, while also backporting future or april fools' Paintings.
body:
![Logo. (it's the logo.)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/230ea3c67b45840983e7484ce2a45c1ef6a24354.png)

A mod that adds a total of **73+** New and Unique Paintings, while also backporting future or april fools' Paintings.

These paintings are added in the total pool of paintings; with many of them varying in size, style and practicality. Some of these paintings were made originally for an Ad Astra Addon mod _(which is still in the works... probably)_, however they are genuinely gorgeous and had to get them released as soon as possible.

![A collection of some of the paintings.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50cac09f432218d51c1c4851b757646c75c31f1c.png)
